instruction: In unique-paths, multiply x by y instead of dividing.
input:
(define (unique-paths m n)
  (for/product ([x (in-range n (+ m (- n 1)))]
                [y (in-range 1 m)])
    (* x y)))
expected:
(define (unique-paths m n)
  (for/product ([x (in-range n (+ m (- n 1)))]
                [y (in-range 1 m)])
    (/ x y)))
